rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the concerns regarding food inflation at 5.42%, I believe the persistence of a 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is increasingly disconnected from the current inflation trajectory. With headline CPI at 3.54% and core inflation at 3.15%, we are effectively below the 4% target. Maintaining a stance of 'withdrawal of accommodation' when the real policy rate is already significantly positive risks overtightening and unnecessarily constraining the 6.80% GVA growth momentum. I agree with the Governor on the necessity of a pause in rate changes given the global uncertainty and food price volatility, but the policy stance must reflect that we have reached a neutral territory. A shift to 'neutral' provides the necessary flexibility to respond to incoming data without signaling a bias toward tightening that is no longer supported by the core inflation dynamics.
